finalText:
CHANGELOG.md is updated. Out of ~380 commits, here's what actually matters, and why:

**Breaking** — `fix(auth): return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` (2026-06-09). This changes a status code contract; anyone branching on 403 for expired tokens needs to update.

**Added** — `feat(webhooks): retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff` (2026-05-28). A real new behavior, touches `core/config.js` too so it likely exposes a retry-policy option.

**Fixed** (9 items) — I grouped near-duplicate fixes that landed separately across modules rather than listing each one:
- DB no longer logs full request bodies (privacy-relevant — was logging potentially sensitive data)
- Null-cursor crashes fixed across four separate paginators (queue, API, webhooks, DB)
- Double-trimmed trailing slashes causing route mismatches (queue, jobs)
- Empty allowlist handling (store, DB, jobs)
- HTTP client timer leak + pool-not-closed-on-shutdown
- Duplicate header on HTTP client requests
- Trace ID dropped across retries (API) — this one actually shipped and regressed twice before the final fix, so I only listed it once
- Wrong units in latency histograms (store, core)
- Vague error messages on malformed tokens (core, billing, queue)

I skipped pure `perf(...)` commits (batch metric writes, JSON round-trip, extra clones) and one "drop the unused v1 export route" refactor — it was already unused, so nobody would notice.

Everything else in the 382 commits was `chore(deps)`, `refactor`, `test`, `ci`, or `docs` — noise for release notes purposes.
